dependencies.acceptance: Released artifact/configuration must initialize a distinct secondary root through supported UI, enforce user presence/reason and destroy or expire cached privileged access.
Supported user/admin UI must grant a finite deadline and expose it to the user. Private extension messages, IndexedDB edits and injected clocks are inadmissible native setup.

Publisher-supported byte endpoint must be bound to the exact native process/artifact, authenticate actual origin and invoke its real permissions/state. A lab CWI adapter is separate component evidence.
Maintainer decision, new major oracle/profile versions and frozen compatibility manifest precede scored evaluation; original clauses and results remain unchanged.
Serve pinned JSON at a declared isolated HTTPS origin/manifest.json; use metanet.groupPermissions and captured real grouped UI, without editing the compiled ToDo artifact.

Close and relaunch Chromium on the same isolated profile with unchanged artifact, sandbox/CA/isolation and normal unlock UI. Preserve identity and continuous provider submission ledger; no private state reads/writes.
Controlled BRC-authenticated /signCertificate service implements nonce/HMAC/signature exchange and independently records plaintext expectations, encrypted fields and authenticated requester identity.
Use an ancestry-verified controlled revocation UTXO and spend it through a supported actor; zero-hash placeholders cannot prove revocation behavior.
Isolated funded fixture sets and public operations, deterministic filters and independently decoded transactions, complete response/error/UI/submission receipts and two fresh native repetitions.

fixtures.definition: Fresh Linux/amd64 Chromium profile, exact released ZIP, admitted mainnet-format mined reserve, controlled Go services; no production funds or undeclared egress.
Separate primary/alternate/manifest origins, fixed public peers/verifiers, native UI dispatch proofs, all decisions and final ledgers retained.
Known external peer/verifier private keys, never native roots; recompute BRC42/69/72 derivations, ECDH and proofs independently.
Distinct known spendable outputs descended from admitted mined reserve, exact signed BEEF and provider evidence; fresh consuming references for each negative case.
At least11 independently identified transactions/outputs/certificates with overlapping/disjoint labels/tags/types, unique descriptions and known inclusion relationships; no hidden store seeding.

Native issuance against authenticated controlled certifier plus separately signed direct certificates, two certifiers/types/verifiers and exactly known fields; independently validate encryption, signature and keyring.
Real controlled certificate revocation UTXO with proof and before/after spend evidence; relinquishment and revocation are different transitions.
Only a separately admitted publisher-native byte endpoint; retain raw frames, endpoint ownership, decoded observations and CWI parity comparison.
Supported UI grants finite UNIX-seconds expiry; observe monotonic real time before/at/after, normal unlock/restart and renewal. No clock mocking in scored native evidence.

interpretations.proposal: Record unsupported privileged keyring explicitly for these artifacts. A narrowed nonprivileged CWI profile may describe its executed scope but cannot set completeBRC100Conformance=true; full-keyring closure needs native feature admission or pinned clarification. Malformed boolean/reason contract tests remain applicable.

Separate expiry0/calendar-month allowance from optional finite-expiry supported configurations. Record unimplemented finite-expiry enforcement as unsupported/unqualified, not passed. Resolve BRC116 mandatory canonical on-chain wording versus optional persistence before any full BRC116 claim; local IndexedDB tests establish only actual local-grant semantics.

Unicode invalid-name probes are separate; bytes and characters coincide for valid ASCII names. Preserve original301–400 nonqualification. Propose direct acceptDelayedBroadcast definition controls: false synchronous, true background, including sendWith. Keep sync completion, eventual delayed submission and terminal rejected preservation separate. Contradictory sendWith prose cannot be silently resolved from SUT behavior.

Record per-case required, mutually exclusive, ignored or rejected semantics before execution. Do not infer all simultaneously supplied optional values are forbidden; cite the specific conflict. Wrong-type leaf tests retain historical outcomes.

Distinguish cryptographic signature validity, external spent revocation token, discovery acceptance and local certificate removal. Specify which public method must check revocation before assigning expected reject; certificate retention itself is not a revocation failure.
